items.title: Localisation preserves exactness of sequences of modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition states that localisation takes an exact sequence of modules to an exact sequence (statement lines 1552-1560, with the author's slogan that localisation is exact). The proof does not invoke flatness of the localisation as a module or a general colimit argument: it observes that being a complex is automatic by functoriality, and then takes a fraction x/s mapping to zero in S^{-1}N, clears denominators to reach v(xt) = 0, lifts xt through the original sequence, and rewrites x/s as the image of y/st (proof lines 1562-1570). The denominator bookkeeping in the exactness half is the substance, and the author performs it step by step. H2.
